61: // cnpgExportImage resolves the digest-pinned CNPG client image for a major.
62: // Empty/unknown falls back to the pinned logicalExportClientVersion image —
63: // never a mutable tag composed from the version string.
64: func cnpgExportImage(version string) string {
65: 	if image, ok := cnpgExportImages[version]; ok {
66: 		return image
67: 	}
68: 	if image, ok := cnpgExportImages[logicalExportClientVersion]; ok {
69: 		return image
70: 	}
71: 	// Unreachable while logicalExportClientVersion stays in the map; kept so a
72: 	// mis-edit fails closed rather than composing a tag.
73: 	return cnpgExportImages["18"]
74: }

53: // applicationDatabaseSpec declares the application database with pgvector
54: // installed (w8/m84). The CNPG images package vector, but CREATE EXTENSION
55: // needs a superuser, which the application owner is not; installed by CNPG, a
56: // migration's `CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS vector` is a no-op and the type,
57: // operators and indexes work for the owner. dbname and owner must be the
58: // database's own (create and restore record them on the spec), since CNPG
59: // creates a missing database; retain keeps the database and its data if this
60: // child is deleted, and no pinned version means CNPG never alters an installed
61: // extension.
62: func applicationDatabaseSpec(clusterName, dbname, owner string) map[string]any {
63: 	return map[string]any{
64: 		cnpgClusterRef:          map[string]any{"name": clusterName},
65: 		"name":                  dbname,
66: 		"owner":                 owner,
67: 		cnpgEnsure:              cnpgPresent,
68: 		"databaseReclaimPolicy": "retain",
69: 		"extensions":            []any{map[string]any{"name": "vector", cnpgEnsure: cnpgPresent}},
70: 	}
71: }
